title: Hinomori Shizuku — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Anyways... We've all been working hard on your birthday celebration, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We know MORE MORE JUMP! will be doing a stream that day, so we'll have our event after that!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe, thank you.
I do wonder what kind of celebration you have in store for me.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hehehe, you'll just have to wait and see!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: Shizuku, can I come in?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, please come in. Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Sorry to bother you, but there's something I wanted your help with.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: My, you want my help...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm so happy you came to me, Shii.
I'll do anything I can to help!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Um, maybe wait until you know what you're agreeing to...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Well, whatever.
So, I was hoping you could stop by...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... First, I pick up your dry cleaning, then I buy a cake at the cafe. Is that right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah. I was going to do both myself, but something came up...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's perfectly fine. Please, leave it to me!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Still... It's quite unusual for you to ask for cake, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's this one Honami told me about. It's supposed to be really good, so I've been wanting to try it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. Then I'll have to be sure to succeed.
Look forward to it, Shii!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Thanks, I will. See you later, then.

rows.Speaker: Shiho's Voice
rows.Line: Alright. Now to send Momoi a message...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Now you've got a mission, Shizuku!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I do. It's not often Shii asks me to do something for her... I want to handle this perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I need to commit the route to memory so I don't get lost on the way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Well, we can help with that!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yeah! There's no way it'll go wrong if we put our heads together! Let's all do our best on this mission♪>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Both of you... Thank you.
I'm going to do my best and make Shii's day!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Now, I'll start by finding out where the cafe is...
Neighborhood

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Phew... I've made it this far without getting lost, so the remainder of the trip should go smoothly as well.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You're doing amazing, Shizuku! But there's no need to fear if you do end up lost, since we're right here with you!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I feel much more confident with both of you here.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I believe I'm supposed to turn right here and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Wait... What?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <What's going on...? They have a sign set up.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It says... “Road closed for construction”...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I'm supposed to go this way... Wh-What do I do...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Try not to panic, Shizuku. Why don't we backtrack a bit and look for a new route?>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, right.
Let's see, we turned right to get here, so...this way?
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Wait, Shizuku! You got yourself turned in the opposite direction!>
Wait... Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?
se_walk_women_001_2
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
It is you, I knew it!
What brings you here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mizuki, Ena!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Well, there's somewhere I'd like to go, but I ran into construction on the route I planned...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I'm trying to figure out another route right now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Got it... By the way, where are you headed?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: First to the dry cleaners, then to a cafe nearby called Lapin.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, Lapin?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I know the place... But isn't it in the opposite direction?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Huh? O-Oh, I see.
I was sure I had these streets committed to memory...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But I suppose I've gotten lost as usual.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, wanna walk together part of the way? We were just on our way to one of the shops on that street.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'd kind of worry if we left you on your own now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let's stick together until you get to a street you recognize.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Really? Thank you!
Then, I'll happily take you up on the offer.
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I've been here before...!
If I remember correctly, going straight here should take me to the correct street.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ooh, correct you are♪
Sounds like you'll be alright without us from here on out!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I should be.
Thank you both so much. You pointed me in the right direction!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
Well, the two of us are headed this way.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I hope you both enjoy your outing.
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sheesh, Airi sure knows how to put her friends to work...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, it's not so bad. I mean, it's for Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Well, you've got a point there.
Anyway, guess I should message Airi.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I'll send one too!
Let's see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Shizuku's headed that way! Make sure everything's ready♪”

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I just hope she actually makes it.
